name: GratuCalc – UAE End of Service Calculator
author: fazalniazi

sections.description:
GratuCalc is a simple and powerful UAE End of Service Gratuity Calculator plugin for WordPress.

Calculate your UAE gratuity for FREE:
Gratuity Calculator UAE

Use the shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] to display the calculator on any page or post.

Why Choose GratuCalc?

  • 100% Free — No subscriptions, no hidden fees
  • Accurate Calculation — Follows UAE Labour Law 2026
  • Mobile Responsive — Works on all devices
  • Lightweight — Fast loading, no performance impact
  • Easy to Use — Simple shortcode integration
  • Beginner Friendly — No coding required

How Gratuity is Calculated:

  • Less than 1 year of service: No gratuity
  • 1 to 5 years of service: 21 days basic salary per year
  • More than 5 years of service: 21 days for first 5 years + 30 days per year after that
  • Maximum gratuity cannot exceed 2 years basic salary

Use Cases:

  1. UAE Employees — Calculate your end of service benefits instantly
  2. HR Professionals — Quick gratuity calculations for employees
  3. Employers — Estimate end of service liability
  4. Accountants — Fast gratuity computation tool
  5. Legal Advisors — Reference tool for UAE Labour Law

Third-Party Service Information:

This plugin uses gratuitycalculatruae.com for reference calculations.

  • Service Website: https://gratuitycalculatruae.com
  • UAE Labour Law Reference: https://gratuitycalculatruae.com/uae-labour-law
  • Privacy Policy: https://gratuitycalculatruae.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] to any page or post.
  4. Publish the page — calculator is ready!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, GratuCalc is completely free with no hidden charges.

Is the calculation accurate?

Yes, it follows official UAE Labour Law 2026 rules for gratuity calculation.

Where can I calculate UAE gratuity online?

Visit https://gratuitycalculatruae.com for a free online calculator.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, GratuCalc is fully mobile responsive.

Can I use it with Elementor or page builders?

Yes, use the shortcode [gratucalc_calculator] inside any shortcode widget.

What is UAE Gratuity?

UAE Gratuity is an end of service benefit paid to employees under UAE Labour Law after completing one year of service.

How is gratuity calculated in UAE?

For the first 5 years: 21 days basic salary per year.
After 5 years: 30 days basic salary per year.
Visit https://gratuitycalculatruae.com for instant calculation.
